messages.subject: Project Ember — Ashby House — Heads of Terms
messages.plaintextBody:
Dominic,

Following agreement between the principals, please find attached the heads of terms for the sale of Ashby House, 40 Curzon Street to Marchwood Property Group at £24.75m. These are subject to contract save for the exclusivity, costs and confidentiality provisions.

We'd be grateful for access to the data room so we can begin title and lease review. We'll raise CPSE.1 and supplementals once we have the documents.

Kind regards
James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0537
